newsitem.title: UK: Firm banks dominate Japanese stocks in London.
newsitem.headline: Firm banks dominate Japanese stocks in London.

text.p: Buying of banking shares dominated trade in Japanese shares in London on Thursday as European and British investors moved into the sector, dealers said.
Buyers were piling in to city banks after a strong performance by the sector in Tokyo, they said.
"The sector has done well in recent days and some people say it's a breakout pattern," one dealer said. "Everybody seems to want to get into them."
The Nikkei 50 index of Japanese shares in London was up 6.8 points, or 0.43 percent, from Wednesday's London close at 1,602.42 by 1437 GMT.
In Japan, the Nikkei 225 closed 274.53 or 1.35 percent higher at 20,564.46.
Dealers said city banks like Sumitomo Bank, Asahi Bank, Mitsubushi Trust and Banking Corp and Sanwa Bank had all seen good buying interest in London.
Trust banks, and the scandal-tainted Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank had seen less interest, they added.
Dealers said some blue-chip ADRs in New York were firmer, notably Sony Corp.
